purpose: Machine-readable contract for authentication, trial start, purchase recovery, external account readiness evidence, sync scope, canonical account reads, idempotent learning events, server scheduling, default sync strategy, and offline behavior.

authentication.remote_auth_request_rule: request-code, verify-code, refresh, and logout each use one bounded deadline that includes response headers, body parsing, and response validation; timeout and cancellation are transport outcomes rather than authorization rejection
authentication.authenticated_request_rule: access-token acquisition, the first protected fetch, at most one forced refresh, and one retry share one bounded deadline; caller cancellation or a changed originating session cancels the request, and cancellation itself cannot trigger refresh, invalidate, or mutate a replacement session
authentication.production_sms_delivery_rule: production must use a receiver-configured non-development SMS adapter; the receiver CloudBase Auth default provider is credential-free only when the exact ap-shanghai environment has PhoneNumberLogin enabled and SmsVerificationConfig.Type=default, while webhook or direct Tencent SMS credentials remain outside tracked files; a fixed verification code is development-only and is rejected from receiver deployment configuration

account_deletion.request_rule: POST /v2/account/deletion derives phone and session only from the signed access token, first reads and strictly normalizes the account-keyed task, and returns an existing queued processing or finalizing task only when account_key phone and origin_session_id exactly match that token; this lost-202 retry remains safe after the worker erased account/session because task presence blocks login refresh protected access and clean re-registration. Only when no task exists does one final transaction require the exact active origin session plus current account instance before persisting account-deletion-task.v2 and beginning exact-generation account-wide revocation
account_deletion.account_instance_rule: softbook_accounts stores one account-instance.v1 document keyed by the derived account key with only account_key random opaque account_instance_id canonical created_at and schema_version; successful sign-in verification atomically consumes the exact challenge, requires its persisted expected account instance generation, creates the account instance only when both expected and current are absent, and writes the bound server session; old or concurrent challenges cannot create a replacement generation
account_deletion.session_authority_rule: every account-scoped HTTP read and write carries the server-derived account_key account_instance_id phone session_id and request checked_at; the final memory critical section or CloudBase transaction requires the exact active non-expired session, canonical phone-bound account key, exact current account instance, and absent deletion task, so an old request cannot read or mutate a clean re-registration generation and legacy sessions without account_instance_id fail closed with re-login required
account_deletion.account_write_fence_rule: every account product-state mutation performs the session authority and deletion-task checks inside the same final storage transaction before writing; any present queued processing future finalizing or malformed task fails closed with account_deletion_pending, covering learning event/state projections, learning-session cursor confirmation and writes, round continuation, Trial activation, check-in, Space migration/state/actions, base membership mutation or expiry reconciliation, and beta/pilot operator entitlements
account_deletion.task_rule: the account-keyed account-deletion-task.v2 stores deletion_id account_instance_id origin_session_id phone derived phone-only rate-limit key attempt count last attempt failure code lease ID lease expiry requested time and queued processing or durable finalizing status; every claim and guarded mutation binds the exact deletion and account-instance generation, queued has no lease, processing has an exact lease pair, finalizing has either the current exact lease pair or no lease while immediately retryable, and unknown fields or malformed or missing lease TTL fail closed
account_deletion.worker_rule: the separately deployed softbook-account-deletion-worker lists at most 50 exact-generation queued expired-processing ready-finalizing or expired-finalizing tasks then claims only when account_key deletion_id account_instance_id and requested_at still match; the returned claimed task is the sole erasure and report authority, every mutation rechecks deletion_id account_instance_id phase and lease, the worker deletes softbook_accounts with the broad account and phone collections, enters durable finalizing, waits or retries until pre-transition outbound challenge reservations are terminal or expired, then performs the final phone-rate and challenge sweep before removing the task last
account_deletion.queue_selection_rule: query oldest queued tasks expired processing leases ready finalizing tasks and expired finalizing leases independently before merging by requested_at and applying the run limit, so live leases cannot starve queued or finalizing retry work
account_deletion.cloudbase_transaction_budget_rule: reserve one outbound challenge in exactly four document operations, revoke one queried exact-instance session in exactly three, and guard one query-selected worker document removal in exactly four; executable fake-CloudBase assertions and the truth harness bind all three counts while query-set enumeration stays outside each bounded transaction
account_deletion.rate_limit_rule: every unauthenticated request-code attempt consumes the HMAC-keyed shared-IP counter before phone validation or any deletion-state check, and shared IP records are never removed by account deletion; task-bound phone counters are deleted only in the finalizing sweep, while finalizing refuses every new phone counter or challenge reservation transactionally
account_deletion.challenge_delivery_rule: every outbound sendCode or provider-owned sendChallenge first persists one local challenge ID plus collision-resistant delivery reservation and bounded provider deadline with pending status; provider-owned verification IDs are conditionally attached only to that still-existing exact local pending reservation and can never upsert a missing intent; provider rejection records delivery_failed while service timeout keeps the reservation pending through its terminal-write grace even when an injected provider ignores abort, neither public acknowledgement creates a verifiable challenge, terminal delivery completion is conditional, and finalizing blocks new reservations then retries while any unexpired pending reservation remains, so supported bounded providers settle before task removal while any ignored late result cannot create a locally verifiable challenge
account_deletion.request_enumeration_rule: ordinary and recovery request-code start one fixed acknowledgement envelope before phone task or provider branch divergence and every success-shaped absent queued processing finalizing malformed phone-limited provider-success provider-rejected or provider-timeout result awaits exactly the configured providerDeliveryDeadlineMs; provider work is bounded inside that envelope, the maximum is 8000ms strictly below the Cloud Function 10000ms timeout and the client 15000ms deadline, task-refused branches create zero phone counter challenge or provider material, provider-owned real and suppressed acknowledgements share one conservative 60-second expiry, failed pending and nonexistent challenges verify only as generic invalid_sms_code, and deletion state appears only after successful purpose-bound SMS verification
account_deletion.retry_rule: partial deletion before finalizing releases only the same live lease back to queued with account_cleanup_incomplete, while a quiescence wait or final-sweep failure releases only that lease to an unleased durable finalizing retry and can never reopen challenge creation; a stale list result cannot claim a replacement deletion_id or requested_at, and a stale worker cannot mutate the wrong phase, complete, or release after another worker owns or removes the task, so post-completion re-registration data is preserved and duplicate timer delivery plus repeated deletion remain idempotent
account_deletion.recovery_sms_rule: a credential-free phone-scoped deletion-recovery SMS flow uses challenges permanently bound to account_deletion_recovery purpose and the existing bounded rate and attempt limits; Web sends both recovery requests with credentials omit and redirect error so ambient cookies response cookies and cross-origin redirects cannot create or carry a general session; request-code never discloses whether the task is absent queued processing finalizing or malformed and creates real outbound material only when the internal task fence permits it; its verify route cannot create an auth session or authorize protected access and only after successful SMS proof returns account-deletion-recovery.v1 with pending plus the exact queued or processing deletion_request projection, none plus safe_to_register true when no task currently exists without claiming acceptance or completion, or retryable account_deletion_finalizing without projecting pending none accepted or completed
account_deletion.mobile_request_rule: the mobile client captures the current remote session generation and Bearer access credential only in memory for one bounded deletion request; this route deliberately bypasses shared proactive refresh and automatic 401 invalidation because a lost response may mean the server already queued deletion and revoked sessions; while that origin is submitting or recoverable unknown, new same-origin authenticated work is quarantined before credential access and every already-running same-origin 401 or 403 bypasses refresh, coordinator invalidation, and generic account cleanup; transport, authorization, timeout, and malformed responses preserve the exact captured origin for idempotent retry, while only an exact HTTP 202 whose sole data.deletion_request fields are id, requested_at, and queued or processing status proves acceptance; a replacement session remains isolated
account_deletion.mobile_cleanup_rule: after exact 202 the mobile client removes the operable authenticated shell but performs zero destructive local cleanup until an exact phone-scoped local-cleanup marker write and readback both succeed; only then may it independently clear plus reread secure auth and revocation state, account bootstrap and user projections, the learning-event outbox, active and quarantined mutation queues, and finally the cleanup marker; marker write or read failure preserves every account store, later cleanup failure stays retryable across restart, cleanup required and retry transitions are explicitly announced to assistive technology, and accepted is rendered only after every durable verification passes while still stating that asynchronous server erasure may be running
account_deletion.web_request_rule: PC Web writes and rereads a credential-free phone-scoped requesting marker before sending the bounded raw deletion request with the current memory-only access credential; the deletion origin quarantines new same-session authenticated work and preserves already-running 401 or 403 responses without refresh, invalidation, or generic queue cleanup; only the same exact HTTP 202 deletion_request shape used by mobile advances the durable marker to accepted, while timeout, authorization, transport, malformed, or lost responses remain result-unknown and preserve the current session plus both credential-free queues for idempotent same-page retry
account_deletion.web_cleanup_rule: an accepted Web marker removes the authenticated shell, stops active or preparing private audio, invalidates only the memory session, clears the account learning-event outbox plus active and quarantined mutation state under an exact resolved-marker cleanup capability, and replaces the marker state with null inside one credential-free single-key revision envelope before accepted presentation; the null envelope revision remains a write epoch rather than becoming unguarded state, every memory session and queue writer binds its exact observed revision, and every queue write rereads that revision so an operation that passed an earlier controller check cannot recreate intent after another tab completes cleanup; ordinary logout and terminal authorization cleanup first persist exact owner plus local_cleanup under the shared Web Lock, then clear both queues under that resolved cleanup authority, and only after both verifications replace it with null at the next revision; a crash or partial failure leaves local_cleanup durable, blocks ordinary SMS and login, and resumes both queue clears without a session after reload; final ordinary SMS verification plus memory-session establishment and writer binding run inside one exact null-epoch authority, and any epoch race revokes the returned session without entering authenticated fallback; every authenticated snapshot rechecks exact session scope and epoch under that authority before controller commit or return; private audio additionally binds exact session scope, epoch, content version and server selection, listens to both cross-tab epoch and auth-session-scope changes, and stops immediately on 401 or 403 invalidation, session replacement, deletion, or same-card new selection; controller start and dispose own all storage and session listener subscriptions, abort active preparation, stop playback, and support StrictMode setup cleanup setup without duplicate listeners; every state transition is one synchronous setItem plus exact readback; any later failure keeps accepted registration_ready or local_cleanup state for reload-safe local cleanup retry; a requesting marker blocks ordinary login presentation and ordinary same-phone authentication without claiming acceptance, while after process reload only the dedicated account_deletion_recovery SMS purpose may inspect the exact marker phone and it never creates a general auth session; exact pending proves the task projection and permits accepted cleanup, while exact none plus safe_to_register true clears old local queues and opens fresh registration without claiming accepted or completed
account_deletion.completion_rule: verified erasure deletes account-deletion-task.v2 last, uses no retained tombstone, and permits clean re-registration with a new random account instance only after the task is gone
account_deletion.report_rule: account-deletion-worker-report.v1 contains counts, generated time, deletion-ID fingerprints, and completed retry_queued retry_finalizing or lease_lost status without phone numbers, account keys, tokens, or document contents
account_deletion.deployment_rule: receiver delivery deploys softbook-api plus the non-HTTP index.accountDeletionWorkerMain function without API auth, SMS, signing, or other custom runtime variables, creates or preserves the exact account-deletion-every-minute timer, and rereads function name, handler, runtime, timeout, empty variable set, and trigger configuration before success; repository implementation and deployment plans are not receiver execution or a completed deletion drill

trial_and_purchase.trial_clock_rule: the server atomically stores canonical trial_started_at and trial_expires_at exactly 120 hours apart when the first valid Learning Session starts the five-day trial; every canonical read derives trial_remaining_seconds from its own server time and atomically transitions an elapsed trial to free before returning it
trial_and_purchase.trial_client_rule: clients display server timestamps and remaining seconds but never start, extend, expire, or reconstruct a remote trial from device time or entry counters
trial_and_purchase.closed_beta_audit_rule: each_grant_or_revoke is idempotent and atomically persisted with actor reason timestamp previous stage resulting stage and expected_account_instance_id in one beta entitlement record while base membership remains unchanged; the private command and HMAC bind the raw instance ID but public plans and reports never expose it
trial_and_purchase.operator_account_instance_rule: beta and controlled-pilot operator commands require expected_account_instance_id; CLI dry-run and apply require one strict current active session with exact 64-hex account key canonical account/session timestamps valid time ordering matching phone and instance and unexpired refresh lifetime, while receiver final transaction rederives account_key and requires exact current instance plus absent task. Pilot and beta receiver/CLI secrets require 32+ chars and 12+ unique chars; public actor campaign grant event and pilot identifiers plus CLI result parsers reject raw account-instance material as well as phone material

default_sync_strategy.learning_state_rule: latest_valid_learning_event_wins_per_card; learning and review completion aggregates plus per-card learning state are derived from accepted events while physical-space and check-in state keep separate authority
default_sync_strategy.physical_space_rule: latest_valid_explicit_space_action_wins unless it violates box knowledge ownership or contract constraints; invalid actions are rejected and client refreshes from server canonical state
default_sync_strategy.physical_space_snapshot_reconciliation: clients preserve each explicit action as a durable credential-free command, read account-level server canonical state before replay, overlay only matching queued actions, and accept the canonical merged response; clients never restore or upload a whole physical-space snapshot
default_sync_strategy.physical_space_write_atomicity: CloudBase account-level canonical reads, legacy migration, dimension-specific merge, immutable action-ledger insert, and state write-back run inside one database transaction with conflict retry
default_sync_strategy.check_in_rule: an authenticated explicit v2 check-in command can only move the account-and-day state monotonically to checked in; learning counters remain event-derived and physical-space counters remain space-derived

canonical_read.identity_rule: derive the account only from the active v2 session; bootstrap never accepts phone_number in its query or body
canonical_read.day_key_rule: mobile derives the China product day from the current instant at fixed UTC+8 through one shared helper; bootstrap, explicit check-in, and local daily presentation must never use the host timezone or the UTC calendar date as independent authorities
canonical_read.missing_state_rule: return explicit empty canonical state for a valid account/day/track; never copy device-local state into a canonical read
canonical_read.cursor_rule: return null when the service has no stored scheduler cursor; do not infer exact cross-device position from device-local state or claim exact resume
canonical_read.consistency_rule: generated_at binds one observation and acknowledged_at remains audit freshness, while bootstrap-component-revisions.v1 supplies owner-scoped monotonic comparison authority; no timestamp or component vector claims one serializable cross-collection transaction

component_revision_rule.wire_rule: one additive top-level component_revisions object preserves bootstrap.v2 and old-client compatibility; do not add revision fields inside the strict space-state.v2 projection
component_revision_rule.membership: base_membership_revision plus beta_entitlement_revision, with pilot_entitlement_revision added only in controlled_pilot bootstrap responses; non-pilot wire shape stays unchanged, updated clients normalize the absent pilot revision to zero, the base revision lives in a rollback-compatible digest-bound sidecar committed atomically with every current base write, missing business state plus missing sidecar reads as zero, a retained legacy business document without a sidecar reads as at least one and creates the sidecar transactionally, an orphan sidecar fails closed, beta reuses its audited revision, and pilot entitlement uses twice its audited revision plus one only after an active grant crosses the immutable profile expiry so the server-derived access transition is monotonic without fabricating an audit event
component_revision_rule.learning: event_server_sequence is the requested-track projection maximum positive server_sequence, every retained legacy card is serialized explicitly with server_sequence zero, the sequence-zero legacy baseline is scoped to the requested China day and may expire on day rollover while positive v2 history cannot regress, session_revision is the account-and-track learning-session revision, and space_revision identifies the physical-space snapshot that owns favorite overlays
component_revision_rule.progress: learning_server_sequence is the account-wide accepted-event sequence, check_in_revision is zero when the exact account-day record is absent and one when present, and space_revision identifies the snapshot that owns favorite and sleeping counts; progress.learning_authority is account_events_v2, legacy_account_baseline, or empty: account_events_v2 requires a positive sequence, non-v2 authority requires sequence zero, empty requires pending_review_count zero, and an unchanged sequence cannot relabel authority
component_revision_rule.space: state_revision is account-wide and lives in the rollback-compatible space-state-revision.v2 sidecar with canonical-state digest and cumulative action bindings; missing canonical state plus missing sidecar is zero, retained v1 sidecars or legacy state are migration input, every newly ledgered batch advances once while exact duplicates do not, and every duplicate ledger requires current binding plus committed lineage or direct proof from current canonical state
component_revision_rule.content: content version and release identity remain scope identity rather than a fabricated monotonic revision
component_revision_rule.owner_read_rule: CloudBase reads the account-day progress projection, account event sequence, and monotonic check-in record in one read transaction so the returned Progress vector describes the returned Progress owner fields; other top-level owners remain a deliberately composed non-global read
component_revision_rule.no_global_revision: the service must not synthesize a scalar bootstrap revision or imply atomic ordering across membership learning progress and space
component_revision_rule.same_revision_rule: within one owner scope the same component vector must preserve owner fields exactly except server-derived presentation values such as trial remaining time; a lower revision is stale or corrupt rather than newer because of generated_at

canonical_read.legacy_pending_review_rule: before the first accepted v2 event, bootstrap derives pending_review_count from the latest valid account-wide legacy daily baseline, with legacy learning states as fallback, rather than from only the requested day; the derived legacy_account_baseline therefore remains stable across China-day rollover at learning_server_sequence zero, while the first accepted v2 event migrates ownership to account_events_v2
canonical_read.content_rule: content version is the SHA-256 of the normalized ordered source; production requires a matching published content-release.v1 descriptor while development may return release_id null
canonical_read.release_publication_rule: the development importer rejects non-null release descriptors; a separate publication pipeline must verify formal content approval before writing content-release.v1
canonical_read.client_rule: an authenticated client may use validated cached state while offline, but must reconcile with this server read before pushing restored state; without previously validated canonical state and required content, mobile keeps a valid session retryable but blocks learning, local persistence of the reconciled snapshot, mutation replay, and product-state writes until bootstrap succeeds and the loaded card-source content version matches
canonical_read.client_projection_mapping_rule: learning card_states, their source metadata, the bootstrap cursor, and Space states are retained account projections and are not constrained by the current content card_count or active source ID; after the bootstrap content identity is validated, mobile maps only source ID, card ID, and interaction ID facts compatible with the loaded current catalog into current-session UI, leaves current selection authority to the validated learning-session response, and uses canonical Progress rather than recounting filtered historical projections
canonical_read.retained_event_replay_rule: after a fresh authenticated bootstrap validates the account and active release, a durable pending learning event keeps its immutable retained content_version, selection_id, track, card, and interaction and replays before mobile asks the scheduler for a replacement current selection; the replay endpoint validates that retained event independently, acknowledgement is exact-once, and only then may mobile load and map the active release; a content or China-day change must not deadlock the outbox behind current-session UI hydration
canonical_read.known_gap: the repository-local CloudBase learning-events.v2 backend, explicit daily check-in, physical-space actions, React Native and PC Web durable producer/replay, server scheduler, and mobile/Web scheduler-session binding are implemented but not deployed; production publication remains unimplemented

endpoint.identity_rule: derive the account only from the active v2 session; reject phone_number, counters, snapshots, and every request field except day_key

command_contract.day_key_rule: require a valid YYYY-MM-DD; mobile captures the China product day at fixed UTC+8 when the explicit action occurs and preserves that exact day during offline replay; the client cannot submit checked_in_today because the endpoint itself is the affirmative action
command_contract.schema_rule: reject unknown fields and any empty, scalar, array, or missing body
command_contract.monotonic_rule: the first valid command moves the account-and-day state to checked in; exact repeats return the already-canonical acknowledgement without another state transition
command_contract.counter_rule: never accept learning, review, favorite, sleeping, pending-review, or total counters; learning aggregates are derived from accepted learning-events.v2 and space aggregates are derived from canonical physical space
command_contract.storage_rule: persist only schema_version, account_key, day_key, checked_in_today true, and acknowledged_at in the independent softbook_daily_check_ins collection
command_contract.storage_adapter_rule: CloudBase may return its system _id; strip only that adapter-owned field before validating the exact five-field business record, and fail closed on every other unknown or malformed field
command_contract.migration_rule: write an independent account-and-day daily-check-in.v2 record and never mutate retained legacy daily documents; first-event migration can still read their unchanged baseline counters while canonical reads overlay the independent check-in
command_contract.transaction_rule: check-in commits monotonically in its own account-and-day record through the same serialized memory store or CloudBase transaction facility; learning-event transactions never overwrite that record, so a concurrent first event cannot lose the action
command_contract.response_rule: return schema_version, day_key, checked_in_today true, and the canonical acknowledged_at; response identity must match the request day

mobile_contract.remote_rule: remote mobile calls only /v2/progress/check-in and sends day_key without phone_number or counters
mobile_contract.trigger_rule: only an explicit user check-in creates the command; learning completion never uploads a daily snapshot because learning-events.v2 owns progress
mobile_contract.offline_rule: persist a credential-free account-scoped check_in_daily_progress command containing only dayKey; replay injects the current access token in memory
mobile_contract.legacy_queue_rule: during hydration convert a persisted sync_daily_progress entry only when its complete legacy snapshot records checkedInToday true, uses a valid day, contains nonnegative integer counters, and has a consistent total; retain only account context and dayKey and discard every other legacy daily snapshot entry
mobile_contract.ack_rule: remove the queued command only after a strict matching daily-check-in.v2 response; a failed, ambiguous, cancelled, or stale-session response keeps the command queued
mobile_contract.recovery_rule: on restart, preserve a queued local check-in only when an exact persisted command matches the active account and bootstrap day; without that command, canonical checked_in_today false clears stale local state, and event-derived counts never confirm check-in
mobile_contract.reconciliation_rule: after remote acknowledgement refresh canonical bootstrap before treating server progress as reconciled

legacy_cutover.scope_rule: no runtime option, legacy token, active v2 session, or unmigrated account can re-enable either snapshot-write route; retained legacy documents are read-only migration input
legacy_cutover.remaining_v1_rule: authenticated card-source and membership reads/mutations use /v2 session-owned routes; their v1 aliases remain a development migration bridge only, and production still rejects every v1 route

endpoint.identity_rule: derive the account only from the active v2 session; reject phone_number, day_key, snapshot counters, complete space snapshots, and every unknown request field

command_contract.batch_rule: require one to twenty immutable actions; each contains exactly action_id, card_id, dimension, value, and client_occurred_at
command_contract.action_id_rule: require a 1-128 character opaque identifier; the same account and action_id with an identical canonical payload returns duplicate while any payload mismatch rejects the complete batch with 409
command_contract.dimension_rule: dimension is exactly favorite or sleep and value is boolean; favorite is a tag while sleep excludes the card from learning without deleting scheduler state
command_contract.content_rule: track, content_version, and every card_id must match the current normalized server card source; production additionally requires its published content-release.v1 descriptor
command_contract.time_rule: client_occurred_at is retained for long-offline ordering but rejected when it is more than five minutes ahead of server time
command_contract.merge_rule: favorite and sleep use independent last-writer-wins clocks with action_id as the deterministic equal-time tie breaker, so an action in one dimension cannot overwrite the other
command_contract.transaction_rule: legacy migration, ledger conflict detection, dimension merge, immutable action records, action lineage, digest-bound revision checkpoint, and rollback-compatible canonical account state commit atomically; a rejected batch commits nothing
command_contract.response_rule: return one ordered result for every submitted action plus the requested track's canonical projection and matching content_version

storage_contract.state_integrity: stored space-state.v2 business fields and each dimension clock/action pair are validated exactly on every canonical read and write; current writes keep the previous package's exact business schema and CloudBase system _id is the only removable adapter field, while a briefly unreleased inline revision is accepted only as a migration floor and stripped on rewrite
storage_contract.state_revision_integrity: the account-keyed space-state-revision.v2 sidecar owns one positive persisted safe-integer revision, canonical-state digest, and deterministic cumulative action digest/result bindings; revision zero exists only when state and sidecar are absent, retained v1 sidecars and exact legacy state are read-only migration inputs, a sidecar without state fails closed, and digest or binding drift cannot silently relabel state
storage_contract.action_integrity: stored ledger payload, canonical digest, result, acknowledgement, and account ownership are validated exactly before duplicate acknowledgement; current ledgers require immutable lineage plus an exact binding in the current cumulative revision authority, while a previous-package ledger without lineage is recoverable only when its applied or stale result is directly proven by current canonical state; superseded old-schema ledgers require a fenced baseline or intermediate dual-write and otherwise fail closed
storage_contract.legacy_migration: old phone and phone-day space documents are read-only input; the first account-scoped v2 read or write migrates each legacy card into both dimension clocks using last_modified_at and deterministic synthetic action ids without deleting the source documents

mobile_contract.durability_rule: persist an account-scoped credential-free apply_space_action command before optimistic UI authority advances
mobile_contract.request_rule: replay preserves every immutable action field and action_id, injects the current access token in memory, and for the same track binds the request envelope to the currently validated content version; it never rebinds an action across tracks
mobile_contract.ack_rule: remove queued actions as acknowledged only after a strict matching space-actions-ack.v2 result of applied, stale, or duplicate and a canonical projection matching track/content
mobile_contract.terminal_rejection_rule: only strict HTTP 409 error codes space_card_not_in_content and space_action_id_conflict are terminal for an immutable queued action; durably quarantine the credential-free command and exact code before removing it from the active FIFO, surface the rejection to the app, continue later mutations, and refresh canonical bootstrap before presenting reconciled space state
mobile_contract.retryable_failure_rule: space_content_version_mismatch, unknown HTTP failures, transport failures, malformed responses, and every non-terminal rejection remain active and block later same-track ordered space actions until retry or explicit reconciliation; an inactive-track action is preserved but rotated past so current-track and account-wide mutations can proceed; authorization and session cancellation retain their separate session lifecycle handling
mobile_contract.content_mismatch_refresh_rule: space_content_version_mismatch requests a fresh canonical bootstrap before one content-rebound retry; when content identity and component revisions remain unchanged it stays queued without an automatic refresh loop
mobile_contract.quarantine_rule: terminal quarantine is account-local, credential-free, bounded, excluded from optimistic overlays and formal acknowledgement counts, cleared on logout with the active queue, and retained only as local diagnostic evidence rather than server approval
mobile_contract.legacy_queue_rule: during hydration migrate each valid legacy sync_space_state card snapshot into deterministic favorite and sleep actions, discard phone_number, day_key, counters, tokens, and malformed snapshots, and never replay the original whole snapshot
mobile_contract.recovery_rule: canonical bootstrap is the base; overlay only active same-account, same-track durable pending actions in queue order, including actions awaiting same-track content-version rebinding; quarantined actions are excluded, so rejected or unqueued device state can never overwrite server authority
mobile_contract.reconciliation_rule: after remote acknowledgement refresh canonical bootstrap before treating space state and scheduler eligibility as reconciled
mobile_contract.terminal_reconciliation_rule: after terminal rejection start a causally later bootstrap request before presenting reconciled space state; that read may correctly return the same state revision because a rejected command committed no canonical change

legacy_cutover.scope_rule: no runtime option, legacy token, active v2 session, or unmigrated account can re-enable physical-space snapshot reads or writes

endpoint.identity_rule: derive the account only from the active v2 session; reject phone_number or any client-supplied account identity

product_alignment.aggregate_rule: learning and review completion counts plus per-card learning state are derived from accepted immutable events; clients never submit canonical counters or learning snapshots

request_contract.batch_rule: one track per request; require one or more events up to a server-configured bound; preserve input order in the acknowledgement
request_contract.schema_rule: reject unknown fields at the request, event, and device_cursor levels

event_contract.selection_id_rule: copy the opaque selection_id from the current learning-session.v1 selection into the immutable event; for each unseen event the server transaction requires the current account-and-track cursor to match selection_id, card_id, phase, and content_version exactly, while an already accepted exact replay remains valid after that cursor is cleared
event_contract.event_id_rule: generate one opaque stable event_id before durable local enqueue and reuse it unchanged for every retry
event_contract.content_version_rule: bind every event to the exact SHA-256 content version used for the answer; the server validates the track, card, interaction, and retained published release in production
event_contract.client_time_rule: preserve a valid RFC3339 client_occurred_at for bounded activity-day attribution, but never use the client clock as membership, entitlement, idempotency, or canonical ordering authority

device_cursor.device_id_rule: use a pseudonymous installation identifier that contains no account or credential material
device_cursor.sequence_rule: use a positive monotonically increasing safe integer allocated before durable enqueue; gaps and out-of-order replay are valid
device_cursor.authority_rule: device_cursor proves replay provenance and detects forks; it is not the scheduler cursor and does not promise exact cross-device resume

idempotency_and_atomicity.exact_replay: return duplicate with the original server_sequence and do not mutate projections; an already accepted byte-equivalent canonical event remains a duplicate when mutable time or content-retention windows later change
idempotency_and_atomicity.stored_event_integrity: before returning duplicate, recompute the canonical digest from the stored immutable payload and track; any mismatch fails closed without acknowledgement or writes
idempotency_and_atomicity.event_id_conflict: the same event key with a different canonical payload rejects the entire request with HTTP 409
idempotency_and_atomicity.device_cursor_conflict: the same device cursor bound to a different event_id rejects the entire request with HTTP 409
idempotency_and_atomicity.mixed_batch_rule: exact duplicates and at most one unseen event may commit together and each receives an explicit result; the unseen event must consume the current selection and a request with multiple unseen events is rejected atomically
idempotency_and_atomicity.selection_conflict_rule: a missing, stale, cross-account, cross-track, or mismatched selection binding rejects the entire request with HTTP 409 before writes
idempotency_and_atomicity.validation_atomicity: any malformed, unauthorized, unknown-content, or conflicting event rejects the entire request before writes
idempotency_and_atomicity.transaction_atomicity: current selection validation, one new immutable event, account server sequence, derived learning and FSRS projections, all migrated-track learning-session projection watermarks, exact input-track selection clearing, and daily progress commit in one transaction; failure leaves no partial acceptance
idempotency_and_atomicity.cloudbase_atomic_batch_rule: the repository-local CloudBase adapter accepts at most 9 input events but at most one may be unseen; the maximum successful fixture of 8 distinct exact duplicates plus one current-selection event uses 32 operations including same-transaction exact session account-instance and deletion fences, while the measured first-event all-track migration uses 23, both below the platform limit of 100
idempotency_and_atomicity.cloudbase_transaction_query_rule: CloudBase transactions use deterministic document reads and writes only; bounded legacy learning queries run before the transaction and a transactionally written account revision fence forces a retry when a v1 write changes that snapshot

server_authority.server_sequence_rule: assign one stable monotonically increasing account-scoped server_sequence to each newly accepted event
server_authority.duplicate_sequence_rule: an exact duplicate returns the previously assigned server_sequence
server_authority.canonical_ordering_rule: server_sequence is canonical ordering; client time and device sequence never override it
server_authority.per_card_state_rule: the highest valid server_sequence for a card is the canonical latest learning event
server_authority.activity_day_rule: derive the China product activity day from validated client_occurred_at within configured retention and future-skew bounds; otherwise reject the event rather than trust an arbitrary day_key
server_authority.entitlement_rule: event acceptance never grants membership or content access; access remains server-authoritative and content delivery remains independently gated

acknowledgement_contract.retry_rule: a missing or ambiguous response must be retried with byte-equivalent canonical event payloads and the same event IDs
acknowledgement_contract.queue_removal_rule: remove an event from the local queue only after an accepted or duplicate result for that event_id
acknowledgement_contract.canonical_refresh_rule: after replay, read /v2/bootstrap again before presenting reconciled server state or sending dependent mutations

mobile_client_contract.storage_rule: persist the outbox under an independent versioned AsyncStorage key; persist the immutable selection-bound event and allocated installation cursor before advancing the card UI
mobile_client_contract.identity_rule: store the account owner only for local queue isolation; never include phone_number or credential material in the learning-events.v2 request body or event payload
mobile_client_contract.cursor_rule: reuse one pseudonymous installation ID and monotonically allocate a positive safe-integer sequence; repair a stale persisted next sequence without reusing an existing cursor
mobile_client_contract.batch_rule: submit exact duplicates plus at most one unseen selection-bound event for one account and one track without compacting, rewriting, or reordering immutable payloads; end a batch at the first track boundary and never answer a second card before the first acknowledgement, bootstrap reconciliation, and next session read
mobile_client_contract.ack_rule: remove events only after a strict ordered accepted-or-duplicate acknowledgement with matching event IDs and positive unique server sequences
mobile_client_contract.retry_rule: retain byte-equivalent events after ambiguous or failed requests; pause automatic retry after a transient failure until network recovery, app foreground, or a newly durably enqueued event
mobile_client_contract.concurrency_rule: serialize replay per originating session; if a durable event arrives or a dependent mutation finishes queueing after an in-flight pass has read its queue, schedule one follow-up pass instead of running concurrently or waiting for an unrelated trigger
mobile_client_contract.recovery_rule: hydrate the account outbox count with authenticated bootstrap; any pending selection-bound event blocks another card completion until strict acknowledgement, post-acknowledgement bootstrap mapping, and a fresh learning-session read; a cached selected card may be answered offline once, but the client cannot choose or enqueue a second card offline
mobile_client_contract.reconciliation_rule: replay only after validated bootstrap and content hydration; while events are pending, queue dependent check-in and space-state mutations and suppress routine canonical refreshes that would overwrite local intent; after any acknowledgement, keep dependent mutations blocked until another bootstrap is fetched and mapped
mobile_client_contract.logout_rule: clear only the signed-out account's queued events while preserving the installation identity and next sequence
mobile_client_contract.account_switch_rule: scope replay, bootstrap, and authenticated HTTP authorization handling to the originating session identity rather than phone number alone; a stale response from a signed-out or replaced session must not refresh, invalidate, clear, hydrate, or change sync state for the current session, including same-phone reauthentication
mobile_client_contract.request_lifecycle_rule: bound token acquisition and each authenticated fetch pipeline to 15000 milliseconds; timeout retains byte-equivalent events and advances retry state, while caller cancellation or originating-session replacement cancels immediately without acknowledging, removing, rewriting, or incrementing retry state for queued events
mobile_client_contract.legacy_queue_rule: discard persisted generic sync_learning_state mutations during hydration, remove the pre-binding learning-event-outbox.v1 key without replaying its unbound entries, and never route active mobile learning completion through /v1/learning/state-sync

migration_boundary.legacy_v1_role: retained daily and learning snapshots are read-only migration input and are never accepted through HTTP after cutover; explicit daily check-in uses /v2/progress/check-in and is not a snapshot
migration_boundary.migrated_account_write_rule: the first accepted v2 event transaction preserves valid retained sequence-zero learning baselines for both tracks before closing migration; both v1 snapshot-write routes always return 410, while v2 check-in can only merge monotonic checked_in_today and cannot overwrite server-derived learning counts or canonical physical-space counts
migration_boundary.production_rule: production continues to reject all v1 routes
migration_boundary.launch_claim_rule: green repository-local backend, explicit check-in, scheduler, mobile binding, memory smoke, or simulated evidence do not satisfy formal content approval, production deployment, or launch readiness

endpoint.identity_rule: derive the account only from the active v2 session; reject every query field except track and reject every request body

algorithm_contract.server_time_rule: apply newly accepted events to scheduler state at canonical server acceptance time; client_occurred_at remains bounded activity-day input and never overrides server_sequence ordering
algorithm_contract.visible_assessment_rule: the server-only mapping never expands the visible two-state self-assessment into four choices

projection_contract.atomicity: current selection validation, one new immutable event, account server sequence, learning projection, FSRS scheduler projection, learning-session projection watermark update and exact selection clearing, and daily progress commit in the same transaction
projection_contract.integrity: every positive-sequence latest card projection has exactly one matching validated scheduler state and no orphan scheduler state is accepted
projection_contract.duplicate_rule: exact event replay does not advance FSRS state, due time, cursor, sequence, or counters
projection_contract.legacy_rule: sequence-zero migrated cards have no invented FSRS history and remain immediately review-eligible until their first accepted v2 event
projection_contract.cursor_rule: a selected card persists in the independent account-and-track softbook_learning_sessions record as an opaque revisioned server cursor with an acknowledged-at plus latest-positive-server-sequence projection watermark; every newly accepted event for the track updates the timestamp component and advances the sequence component, first-event all-track migration synchronizes every migrated track while preserving valid sibling cursors, only one unseen completion carrying the exact current selection_id, card_id, phase, and content_version clears the cursor atomically, exact duplicate replay remains valid after clearing, and a session read requires the complete matching watermark plus transactional revision confirmation before returning a resumed cursor

selection_contract.single_card_rule: return at most one selection and never return card body content
selection_contract.existing_cursor_rule: resume an eligible persisted cursor before selecting another card only after its learning-projection watermark matches and its revision is transactionally confirmed
selection_contract.due_rule: select an accessible non-sleeping due review before every new card; order by earliest due time, then canonical card-source index, then card_id
selection_contract.new_card_rule: when no review is due, select the first accessible non-sleeping unseen card in normalized ordered card_records
selection_contract.future_rule: when no due review or new card exists, return selection null plus the earliest future next_due_at when one exists only after transactionally confirming the matching learning-projection watermark and session revision
selection_contract.sleep_rule: canonical physical-space sleeping state removes a card from resume, due, new, and next-due selection without deleting its learning or FSRS state
selection_contract.membership_rule: the first authenticated learning-session entry starts an available trial exactly once only after canonical context validation, non-null selection generation from the same stable prefix already authorized by the trial-available card-source response, selection-ID generation, required cursor persistence, and an exact membership checkpoint recheck succeed; every resumed, fresh, empty, or round-completion response rechecks stage, acknowledged_at, and base, beta, and pilot component revisions after cursor acceptance; Trial activation conditionally matches the persisted selection and that same checkpoint inside one CloudBase transaction that reads base membership plus beta and controlled-pilot entitlement, so concurrent premium grant, revoke, or base mutation forces bounded rescheduling and cannot start or overwrite base Trial; trial and premium may schedule the full library after activation, while free and trial-available schedule a stable release-scoped prefix of ceil(card_count * 0.5) in canonical card-source order
selection_contract.content_rule: selection binds to the exact normalized content_version and source; production still requires a matching published content-release.v1 descriptor

mobile_binding_contract.session_read_rule: remote mobile learning reads authenticated learning-session.v1 and the canonical card source, requires matching track, source_id, and content_version, and resolves only the returned card_id; it never applies client membership, sleep, review, or catalog ordering to replace the server selection
mobile_binding_contract.membership_reconciliation_rule: when learning-session.v1 membership_stage differs from the bootstrap snapshot, remote mobile refreshes canonical bootstrap and requires the exact stage before presenting the selection; it never synthesizes entitlement counters or dates from the session response
mobile_binding_contract.completion_rule: the mobile completion event copies the returned selection_id and phase and must match the selected card and exact content version before durable enqueue
mobile_binding_contract.advance_rule: after durable enqueue the completed card may leave the interaction surface, but no next card is selected until strict event acknowledgement, bootstrap reconciliation, and a fresh learning-session.v1 read
mobile_binding_contract.offline_rule: a previously validated cached selection and matching content may be answered once offline; without that pair learning stays blocked, and no second card may be selected locally
mobile_binding_contract.empty_rule: selection null is a valid server result and does not trigger bundled-card fallback or client ordering

server_scheduler_v1.launch_claim_rule: a green repository-local scheduler, mobile binding, memory smoke, or simulated evidence does not prove deployed integration, production entitlement, formal content approval, or launch readiness
